home: Immersive media → lifestyle categories → arrivals → editorial/marquee → email
collection: 4-column rhythm; product-image navigation; price/sale and Choose actions; color filters; 97-item selected collection
pdp: Large stacked gallery and adjacent compact purchase rail; named size radios and separate fit/material content

tradeoff: Campaign scale can overshadow category labels; video and a large image sequence need bandwidth and motion controls
lesson: Transfer compact category navigation and fit context; replace brand spectacle with a purposeful outfit-to-size path

home: Winter lifestyle hero → brand introduction → shop-the-look → categories → accessories
collection: Sidebar filters expose product type, color and price; regular image cards stay subordinate to room photography
pdp: Thumbnail-led bedroom gallery; size select plus color swatches; material and care support
visual: Newsreader serif with Red Hat Display; warm cream/cocoa; restrained borders; generous intervals
tradeoff: Editorial rooms need useful product mapping; a large room photo alone does not establish dimensions or delivery eligibility
lesson: Transfer room categories and persistent material context; do not imply an operational interior-design service

home: Bold condiment hero → flavor range → featured packs → founder/family story → recipes
collection: Large bottle/food images, product names, flavor descriptions and price; small assortment rather than a technical grid
pdp: Bottle-led gallery with pack-size choices; quantity and purchase beside ingredients and preparation context
visual: Barlow Condensed with Inter; saturated red, cream and dark text; assertive typography
tradeoff: Flavor language needs explicit ingredient/allergen data; a purchase action alone cannot tell dietary suitability
lesson: Transfer pack-size clarity and recipe-to-product links; no invented nutritional or allergen claims

nav: Shop / collections / team or story links
home: Asymmetric action hero → performance products → team/brand storytelling → category content
collection: Fins collection has 8 products; regular compact grid, filter/sort and option entry
pdp: Large product gallery with performance/condition explanation and size chips; SMALL selection exercised

tradeoff: Dark expressive treatment can make long technical copy tiring; some initial media captures were incomplete
lesson: Transfer activity vocabulary and compatibility support; do not treat all outdoor equipment as one sizing model

nav: Bags / accessories / collection links with counts
home: Large serif statement → asymmetric product/editorial juxtaposition → collection links → considered product stories
collection: Airy product list with substantial negative space; minimal facts on cards; category counts support browsing

visual: Newsreader light display and Red Hat Text; mostly white/black; exceptionally large display scale
tradeoff: Very large titles consume mobile space; minimal cards make comparison slower for an unfamiliar range
lesson: Transfer curated asymmetry for small catalogs; preserve clear prices and category entry before long editorial content

approach: small range, maker narrative and direct purchase
nav: Sparse shop/story utility rather than deep taxonomy
home: Featured Unfold bags with color purchase controls → social proof content → process/journal → maker story

pdp: Long 18-media gallery; descriptive construction details and color chips; Gray selection exercised

tradeoff: A homepage buy control suits a tiny range but does not generalize to 200 SKUs; long gallery raises scroll cost
lesson: Transfer maker process and direct selection for a genuinely small range; personalization requires additional contracts

home: Bold campaign panels → asymmetric fashion collage → product/category modules → lookbook
collection: Persistent sidebar on desktop and regular 3-column merchandise region; price, color and size filtering
pdp: Large garment image plus purchase rail; native Size and Color dropdowns; Size M selected in probe
visual: Jost; bright blue and contrasting panels; strong blocks and irregular editorial rhythm
tradeoff: Photography creates much of the effect; native selects can hide the size range until opened; media loaded inconsistently in early captures
lesson: Transfer editorial blocks selectively; make fit information structurally visible instead of relying on color drama

home: Gradient rounded hero → product benefits → curated skincare → educational support → email
collection: 15-product skincare collection; rounded regular cards with price and availability plus filters

tradeoff: Soft palettes still need control contrast; beauty imagery is not evidence of efficacy or suitability
lesson: Transfer a clear base-versus-applicator choice and ingredient education; reject automatic clinical claims

home: Oversized graphic hero → bold benefit panels → products → ingredient/brand story
collection: Split collection banner combines context and media, followed by regular product grid
pdp: Cleanser layout combines factual benefit modules, product media, compact quantity and pill purchase control; no radio variant in selected fixture
visual: Liter; hot orange hero, soft purple and brown panels; large graphic headings
tradeoff: Large brand lettering can delay concrete product identification; benefits need substantiation and readable contrast
lesson: Transfer modular ingredient/benefit explanation with evidence; reserve a compact product summary for functional discovery

home: Split outlined hero → featured food/drink cards → bundle merchandising → recipe/editorial modules

pdp: Green bundle uses standard gallery, quantity and descriptive bundle contents; selected product has no extra option

tradeoff: Monospace supporting text has limited capacity for long ingredient lists; a sold-as-one bundle is not a configurable bundle engine
lesson: Transfer explicit package contents and clean divisions; treat inventory coupling as a separate commerce decision

home: Slideshow overlay → featured care products → quality/ingredient statements → supporting story

tradeoff: A slideshow can obscure the stable value proposition; claims and assurances must match merchant policy
lesson: Transfer a single clear care proposition and specification blocks; LetBuyy Refresh being food is an independent mapping

home: Workspace hero → bento category/media modules → featured objects → design story

tradeoff: Decor and chargers have different information requirements; technical compatibility cannot be inferred from a desk setting
lesson: Transfer task-based navigation and compact dimension tiles; separate electronics compatibility from decoration

home: Large typographic capsule introduction → category cutouts → featured styles → campaign/marquee
